title.en: UK oval cylinder (uPVC and composite doors)
title.zh: 英标椭圆锁芯（uPVC 与复合门）

summary.en: The cylinder on most British uPVC and composite doors. It is oval rather than round-profiled, sits in a multipoint gearbox, and is the component that gets snapped by attackers — which is why TS007 star ratings exist.
summary.zh: 英国 uPVC 与复合门上的锁芯。它是椭圆而非圆形槽型，装在多点联动齿轮箱里，也是攻击者最常折断的部件——TS007 星级评定因此存在。

en: Oval profile body, longer and flatter than a euro cylinder
Multipoint gearbox behind it, driving hooks and rollers up and down the door edge
Full-length handle that must be lifted to throw the bolts
zh: 椭圆槽体，比欧标锁芯更长更扁
其后是多点齿轮箱，带动门边上下的钩与滚轮
长把手，需要上抬才能上锁

typical.en: Oval cylinders are specified by overall length and the screw position; common totals 62–92 mm
typical.zh: 椭圆锁芯按总长与螺钉位置标注；常见总长 62–92 mm

how.en: Overall length plus the offset of the fixing screw from one end.
how.zh: 总长，加上固定螺钉距一端的偏移量。

typical.en: 92 mm on most British uPVC and composite doors; 85 mm and 72 mm also exist
typical.zh: 英国多数 uPVC 与复合门为 92 mm；也有 85 mm 与 72 mm

tolerance.en: None — this decides whether a handle fits
tolerance.zh: 无公差——把手能否装上由它决定

how.en: Spindle centre to cylinder centre, measured on the gearbox face (the PZ dimension).
how.zh: 在齿轮箱端面上量方轴中心到锁芯中心（即 PZ 尺寸）。

typical.en: 205 / 215 mm screw centres are the two common values
typical.zh: 常见螺钉孔距为 205 / 215 mm 两种

how.en: Top screw hole to bottom screw hole on the handle.
how.zh: 量把手上螺钉孔到下螺钉孔的距离。

typical.en: Gearbox width 16 / 20 mm; centre distance 92 mm most common
typical.zh: 齿轮箱宽 16 / 20 mm；中心距以 92 mm 最常见

how.en: Remove the handle and measure the gearbox face.
how.zh: 拆下把手，量齿轮箱端面。

how.en: Measure the leaf only, not the frame.

notes.en: Retrofit motors must rotate the cylinder far enough to lift the handle and throw the multipoint bolts — that is several turns, not the single turn of a simple deadlock. If the door only latches on closing, a single-throw motor is enough.
notes.zh: 改造电机必须把锁芯转到足以抬起把手并上锁多点钩舌——这是数圈旋转，而不是简单插销锁的一圈。如果门只是关门即锁，单圈电机就够。

en.a: The cylinder passed independent attack testing for snapping, picking, drilling and bumping on its own. A 1-star cylinder is only acceptable when paired with a 2-star handle.

en.q: Can I keep my old cylinder and add a motor?
en.a: Yes mechanically, but if the old cylinder is unrated you keep the weakest part of the door. Upgrade to a 3-star cylinder at the same time.

zh.a: 该锁芯单独通过了针对折断、技术开启、钻孔与撞击的独立攻击测试。一星锁芯只有在配二星把手时才可接受。

zh.q: 能保留旧锁芯只加电机吗？
zh.a: 机械上可以，但如果旧锁芯没有等级，你就保留了门上最薄弱的一环。建议同时升级为三星锁芯。
